a: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
p: Fa-ṣbir inna waʿda-llāhi ḥaqq, wa lā yastakhiffannaka-lladhīna lā yūqinūn.
m: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
